lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a spec requires a security property of an algorithm constant time compare csprng source assert the property itself not just the boolean result a result only test passes an early exit rewrite unchanged
lessons.text: When a spec requires a security property of an algorithm (constant-time compare, CSPRNG source), assert the property itself, not just the boolean result — a result-only test passes an early-exit rewrite unchanged.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::testing a pure header policy builder does not cover the wiring that decides when to apply it assert the composed response from the middleware for each conditional branch sensitive vs non sensitive path
lessons.text: Testing a pure header/policy builder does not cover the wiring that decides when to apply it; assert the composed response from the middleware for each conditional branch (sensitive vs non-sensitive path).

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::every cookie the app sets needs its attributes samesite secure path max age asserted on the emitted set cookie header not just its value attribute downgrades are silent and security relevant
lessons.text: Every cookie the app sets needs its attributes (SameSite, Secure, Path, Max-Age) asserted on the emitted Set-Cookie header, not just its value — attribute downgrades are silent and security-relevant.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::a guard that collapses distinct denial reasons into one null return cannot honour per reason redirect targets return a discriminated result when the spec names different destinations for different failures
lessons.text: A guard that collapses distinct denial reasons into one null return cannot honour per-reason redirect targets; return a discriminated result when the spec names different destinations for different failures.

lessons.key: ac_gap::never list a requirement id in a describe test label unless that block actually asserts it a mislabelled block reads as coverage during review and hides a zero evidence ac
lessons.text: Never list a requirement ID in a describe/test label unless that block actually asserts it — a mislabelled block reads as coverage during review and hides a zero-evidence AC.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a dev mode relaxation of a security control adding unsafe eval under isdev contradicts an unconditional shall not record it as an explicit spec exception rather than encoding it silently in a branch
lessons.text: A dev-mode relaxation of a security control (adding 'unsafe-eval' under isDev) contradicts an unconditional SHALL NOT; record it as an explicit spec exception rather than encoding it silently in a branch.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::extracting a branch into a testable pure module only covers the decision not the call site assert the consuming wiring too or the mapping from decision to effect redirect target header status can be flipped with every test still green
lessons.text: Extracting a branch into a testable pure module only covers the decision, not the call site — assert the consuming wiring too, or the mapping from decision to effect (redirect target, header, status) can be flipped with every test still green.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a shared error response helper needs every call site covered not just the ones the spec names an uncovered branch can be rewritten to leak a distinguishing message while the helper s own tests stay green
lessons.text: A shared error-response helper needs every call site covered, not just the ones the spec names — an uncovered branch can be rewritten to leak a distinguishing message while the helper's own tests stay green.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a config file must be duplicated into an embedded heredoc enforce parity with a diff based gate command not a keep these identical comment drift passes every syntax gate silently
lessons.text: When a config file must be duplicated into an embedded heredoc, enforce parity with a diff-based gate command, not a "keep these identical" comment — drift passes every syntax gate silently.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a least privilege acceptance criterion that only forbids owner editor still admits a project scoped predefined admin role state the required resource scope in the ac not just the role names
lessons.text: A "least privilege" acceptance criterion that only forbids owner/editor still admits a project-scoped predefined admin role; state the required resource scope in the AC, not just the role names.

lessons.key: ac_gap::before scoping a cloud iam role from project level down to a single resource enumerate the cli s actual api calls against the provider s documented permission list collection level and operations reads compute projects get instances list zoneoperations get can never be granted by a resource level binding so zero project level role may be unachievable
lessons.text: Before scoping a cloud IAM role from project level down to a single resource, enumerate the CLI's actual API calls against the provider's documented permission list: collection-level and operations reads (compute.projects.get, instances.list, zoneOperations.get) can never be granted by a resource-level binding, so 'zero project-level role' may be unachievable.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::terraform validate is a syntax type gate only it accepts an empty source ranges a deleted iam binding a removed variable validation block and a project wide iam member add credential free grep assertions to ci for each security invariant instead of trusting fmt validate
lessons.text: terraform validate is a syntax/type gate only - it accepts an empty source_ranges, a deleted IAM binding, a removed variable validation block, and a project-wide IAM member; add credential-free grep assertions to CI for each security invariant instead of trusting fmt/validate.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a terraform variable validation block is evaluated only at plan time with a concrete value so terraform validate proves nothing about it assert the rule s logic separately or accept it is review only
lessons.text: A Terraform variable validation block is evaluated only at plan time with a concrete value, so terraform validate proves nothing about it - assert the rule's logic separately or accept it is review-only.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an amendment narrows a resource an earlier feature s spec declared firewall breadth iam scope update that earlier spec tasks in the same commit the stale spec otherwise reads as the intended state and no validator compares a spec to the code
lessons.text: When an amendment narrows a resource an earlier feature's spec declared (firewall breadth, IAM scope), update that earlier spec/tasks in the same commit - the stale spec otherwise reads as the intended state and no validator compares a spec to the code.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a change makes an access path opt in via a variable defaulting to off document that applying it to an existing deployment revokes the current access the destroy is silent in plan output to anyone not reading resource by resource
lessons.text: When a change makes an access path opt-in via a variable defaulting to off, document that applying it to an existing deployment revokes the current access - the destroy is silent in plan output to anyone not reading resource-by-resource.

lessons.key: ac_gap::before granting a cli the permissions a cloud doc lists check which branch of the doc s conditional applies to this resource gcloud compute ssh writes the ephemeral key to project metadata unless the vm sets block project ssh keys true so the instance scoped setmetadata grant covers a path gcloud never takes
lessons.text: Before granting a CLI the permissions a cloud doc lists, check which branch of the doc's conditional applies to this resource: gcloud compute ssh writes the ephemeral key to project metadata unless the VM sets block-project-ssh-keys=TRUE, so the instance-scoped setMetadata grant covers a path gcloud never takes.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a ci guard that allowlists an exception by resource or symbol name lets an offender inherit the exemption by reusing that name allowlist the permitted value the guard actually cares about not the identifier
lessons.text: A CI guard that allowlists an exception by resource or symbol name lets an offender inherit the exemption by reusing that name; allowlist the permitted value the guard actually cares about, not the identifier.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::scope a static security guard to every file that can express the invariant not the one file that currently does a rule moved to a sibling file a variable default or a widened permission list evades a single file grep with all gates green
lessons.text: Scope a static security guard to every file that can express the invariant, not the one file that currently does: a rule moved to a sibling file, a variable default, or a widened permission list evades a single-file grep with all gates green.
